name: project-work-identity-merge
adaptation: Reuse Systematic Reviewer MAIN exact normalized identifier alias lookup and durable old-item-key chain compression in the existing References project SQLite worker and identifier index; no scratch database, collection workflow, title matching or separate identity service is imported.

Keep V3 strict identifier parsing and abstract reconstruction. Add explicit DOI URL wrappers and OpenAlex work identifiers. A normalized DOI/PMID/PMCID/OpenAlex/arXiv match is sufficient; conflicting secondary values remain normalized aliases and visible provenance, never fabricated corrections. Book ISBN identity stays book-scoped; journal/ISSN identifiers are not work identities.

Adapt native same-library transaction, child-parent rebind, tags/relations union, earliest-date and source-trash/replacement semantics to the existing References records and registered attachment owner. The user explicitly requires all distinct attachment records/files to remain, including identical bytes; do not port native attachment deduplication.

All SQLite mutation paths atomically match, preserve manual fields, enrich missing metadata/longer valid automatic abstracts, retain prior/incoming raw provenance receipts, and flatten old citation keys. Canonical-field corrections replace active aliases of that kind while preserving history. Imports and user/Pi edits share this one store path.

One-time versioned index migration uses 200-row keyset pages off the HTTP loop. Runtime matching uses indexed kind/value lookups and bounded duplicate groups, never a full-library title scan. The worker uses native BEGIN IMMEDIATE and SQLite busy timeout; only competing fresh WAL setup receives a bounded retry.
